what: What you can do with Asc-Seurat
title: Asc-Seurat
text: Load data many formats — 10X Genomics directories, 10X HDF5, CSV/TSV count matrices, AnnData, existing Seurat objects. Quality control filtering — interactive violin plots, per-cell metric thresholds, optional doublet removal. Normalization clustering — LogNormalize SCTransform, UMAP t-SNE embeddings, built-control rename clusters biological labels moving . Differential expression — cluster markers, -cluster DE, -sample DE integrated datasets. Multi-sample integration — declare samples inline (separate config file), set per-sample QC, integrate RPCA (Seurat) Harmony. Trajectory inference — three supported methods: Slingshot, PAGA, Monocle 3. User can also identify trajectory-associated genes. Cell-type annotation — automated labelling reference atlases. Advanced plots — stacked violin multi-gene dot plots, control gene cluster ordering. Per-gene plot bundles — download zipped collection every plot selected gene one click. Bookmarking session reports — capture state analysis reproduce share later.

title: ascseurat 3.0.2
text: Docker runtime now includes libuv1t64 Shiny/httpuv, libwebpmux3 ragg graphics devices, libnode109 V8/node-linked packages. Package GitHub Actions now install hard/runtime dependencies, avoiding pak’s optional GitHub sub-directory remote path BPCells; Docker release workflow remains full optional-stack runtime gate. Docker smoke tests now preserve container logs failure.

title: ascseurat 3.0.1
text: README install instructions now pre-install BPCells via remotes running pak::pkg_install. Works around pak 0.9.5 issue GitHub sub-directory remotes blocked install monocle3 downstream packages. Docker image runtime stage slimmed: dropped compile-time *-dev packages now relies runtime shared libraries already shipped rocker/r-ver:4.5.3 (Ubuntu 24.04) base. Local image ~4.8 GB. Docker build CI split native linux/amd64 linux/arm64 jobs (QEMU emulation) now triggers v* release tags manual workflow dispatch. Docker Hub multi-arch manifest: pereiralabbio/asc-seurat:3 :latest now resolve transparently native variant Apple Silicon x86. GitHub releases auto-archive Zenodo.

title: ascseurat 3.0.1
text: Read Docs site rewritten match v3 editorial UI drop v2 migration-narrative framing throughout.

title: ascseurat 3.0.0
text: Refactored codebase flat Shiny app proper R package. app now installable via remotes::install_github("Pereira-Lab-UF/asc_seurat") launched ascseurat::run_app(). Updated Seurat v5 throughout. Old Seurat v3/v4 RDS files automatically updated load via UpdateSeuratObject(). New modular Shiny architecture (mod_*_ui / mod_*_server).

title: ascseurat 3.0.0
text: Dynverse / dyno trajectory inference. Removed Dynverse required Docker--Docker, slow, frequently broke releases. Replaced supported Slingshot, PAGA, Monocle 3 workflows. biomaRt online annotation. Removed required working internet connection Ensembl BioMart server frequently . Replaced offline GO enrichment via clusterProfiler + organism-specific Bioconductor org.*.db packages. rclipboard copy buttons. used practice added JS dependency.

title: ascseurat 3.0.0
text: H5AD (AnnData) input via anndataR. RPCA integration (Seurat v5 IntegrateLayers). PAGA Monocle 3 trajectory inference methods Shiny workflow. PseudotimeDE-fast recommended default trajectory differential expression engine Slingshot outputs, scMaSigPro optional tradeSeq alternatives. Cell-type renaming UI clustering tab. Per-gene plot-bundle (zip) download.
